item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
Lumary Audio 1.5
Monitor: your headphones and speakers, corrected, for everything you hear.
• New Monitor workspace (⌘3), beside Live and the Recorder. Turn MONITOR on and every app's sound goes through it: music, videos, your DAW, Live and tapes. Turn it off and nothing changes. It's in the menu bar too.
• Pick your headphones from 690 models, from Sennheiser, Beyerdynamic and Audio-Technica to Meze, Focal, Audeze, HIFIMAN and AirPods Max, and Monitor corrects them to a neutral sound. Star your favorites to keep them at the top of the list.
• TARGET chooses Harman's sound or a flatter bass, AMOUNT how much to correct, and CROSSFEED makes wide mixes feel less inside your head. On speakers, PLACEMENT takes out the bass a desk, a wall or a corner adds.
• A 10- or 31-band EQ with presets for Rock, Pop, Jazz, Classical, Hip-Hop, Electronic and more. Drag the faders, or draw the curve right on the scope. BASS, TREBLE, BALANCE and VOLUME too.
• Each output remembers its own settings, so your headphones and your speakers each sound right.
• Only what you hear changes. Your recordings and the virtual mic stay exactly as they were.
The first time you turn MONITOR on, macOS asks to let Lumary Audio record system audio. That's how it reaches other apps' sound. Nothing is recorded.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
